meta.title: Press & Media - Open Healthcare Network Foundation
meta.description: Media boilerplate, public facts, logos, and source-aware guidance for Open Healthcare Network Foundation and CARE.

hero.title: Clear language for the foundation and CARE.
hero.body: Use source-aware language when covering OHC Foundation, CARE, and open healthcare digital public infrastructure. Impact numbers should be checked against the metrics register before publication.

boilerplate.title: About Open Healthcare Network Foundation
boilerplate.foundation: Open Healthcare Network Foundation stewards open digital public infrastructure for healthcare. The foundation maintains CARE and related open-source building blocks that help governments, hospitals, NGOs, and implementation partners deploy interoperable, self-hostable, standards-based health systems without vendor lock-in.
boilerplate.care: CARE is an open-source Digital Public Good for healthcare workflows across hospitals, public health programs, critical care, palliative care, and care coordination. It is designed around open standards, modular architecture, and real-world frontline adoption.

facts.title: Use these as the publication floor.

role.title: Foundation role
role.text: Open Healthcare Network Foundation stewards CARE and related open-source Digital Public Goods for healthcare.

dpg.title: CARE DPG listing
dpg.text: CARE is listed in the Digital Public Goods registry as Care | Open Healthcare Network and is MIT licensed.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.text: CARE is built in public with open-source repositories, contribution pathways, and reusable deployment patterns.

standards.title: Standards-first
standards.text: OHC public materials describe CARE around FHIR R5, SNOMED CT, LOINC, UCUM, ICD-10, ABDM, and open APIs.
